description: Gold queries for the regulatory reference. 'answer' = the corpus can answer and the guard must let the result through; 'abstain' = the corpus cannot answer and the copilot must abstain. Written by the corpus author BEFORE the guard was tuned; 'known_gap' marks queries the guard is not expected to catch (kept visible on purpose). expected_rules are the PROVEN or ASSUMED rules a good answer would include; they are scored against live Cortex Search only, never offline.
scope: India, PMLA 2002, FIU-IND and RBI guidance for banks and financial institutions. Corpus v1.1.0.

holdout_note: H01-H10 were written after the unknown-acronym rule was added and are the only queries not used to shape that guard. J01-J25 (holdout 2) were written on 2026-10-06 BEFORE the generic foreign-regime screen was designed, from the question styles a reviewer would try (a foreign place with no 'law/requirements' cue word, a foreign regulator, a foreign form name); they are frozen, the guard's first measurement on them is evidence/retrieval-gold/<date>/holdout2_baseline.json, and after the guard is changed they become a regression record. Reported separately. L01-L20 (holdout 3) were written on 2026-10-06 AFTER the generic screen was designed and implemented and BEFORE it was measured on them: a fair test of whether the implementation generalises to new phrasings, not of design blindness. They are measured once; misses are listed, and any change made after that is a regression record.
